items.headline: Andrew Conrad's 55-yard FG with 2 seconds left lifts East Carolina over South Florida 20-17
items.description: — Andrew Conrad's 55-yard field goal with two seconds left in the game lifted East Carolina to a 20-17 victory over South Florida on Friday night.

items.headline: Two fumble returns for touchdowns highlight South Florida's 30-10 win over UAB
items.description: — Asani Redwood and Grayson Howard returned fumbles for touchdowns and CJ Hicks had four sacks, leading South Florida to a 30-10 victory over UAB on Saturday, making the Bulls bowl-eligible for the fourth consecutive season.
